name: Spam Word Blocker
author: Harshit Kumar

sections.description:
Spam Word Blocker is a lightweight, WordPress policy-compliant plugin that prevents publishing or scheduling of any post, page, or custom post type if the content contains unwanted words defined by the admin.

Key Features

  • Instant Popup Alert (Pure Vanilla JS) – Shows exactly which blocked words were found with zero jQuery dependency.
  • Publish & Schedule Protection – Blocks both immediate publishing and scheduled (future) posts, plus optional Pending Review blocking.
  • Gutenberg & Classic Editor Ready – Scans Title, Content, Excerpt, and optional URL Slug accurately in modern iframe block editors.
  • Post Type & Role Controls – Choose which public post types to protect and optionally allow trusted roles to bypass.
  • Instant Blocklist Tester – Test sample sentences right from the settings page.
  • 1-Click Export / Import (.txt) – Easily move your blocklist across websites.
  • Recent Blocked Attempts Log – Track the last 20 blocked publish attempts with user, post title, and matched words.
  • Server-Side Enforcement – Cannot be bypassed and scales cleanly to large blocklists.

Perfect For

  • Multi-author blogs and newsrooms
  • Guest post moderation
  • Preventing accidental spam or restricted keywords
  • Brand and AdSense policy protection
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel and go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “Spam Word Blocker”.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Go to Spam Word Blocker in your admin menu, add your blocked words (one per line), and click Save Settings & Blocklist.
sections.faq:
Does it work for custom post types?

Yes. By default it protects all public post types, and you can toggle specific post types in the settings.

Does it block scheduled posts too?

Yes. Both immediate Publish and Scheduled (future) posts are enforced server-side.

Can I allow Administrators to bypass the blocklist?

Yes. Use the “Bypass Roles” checkboxes in the Spam Word Blocker settings page.

Will it slow down my site?

No. It has zero frontend footprint and only runs in the editor and during post publish events.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Tested and verified for WordPress 7.2 and PHP 8.6 compatibility.
  • Rewrote editor checker in 100% pure Vanilla JS (removed jQuery dependency for jQuery 4 readiness).
  • Fixed Gutenberg iframe title and excerpt detection using wp.data.select('core/editor').
  • Added server-side protection for Scheduled (future) posts and optional Pending Review submissions.
  • Added Protected Post Types, Scan Scope (Title, Content, Excerpt, Slug), and Role Bypass settings.
  • Added Instant Blocklist Tester, 1-Click Export/Import (.txt), and Recent Blocked Attempts Log (last 20).
  • Chunked regex matching for large blocklists and fixed double-escaping in admin notices.
  • Moved settings save handler to admin_init for full Plugin Check compliance.

1.1.0

  • NEW: Instant popup modal showing blocked words.
  • IMPROVED: Simplified code structure and WordPress policy compliance.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
